brief: The 7-CLI stack a senior engineer actually uses every day.

slots.heroBody: Interactive fuzzy finder that filters files, history, and processes with blazing speed.
slots.slideSubtitle: Stop memorizing paths; just type fragments and watch fzf narrow results instantly.

slots.heroBody: Line-oriented search tool that recursively searches your directory for a regex pattern.
slots.slideSubtitle: Ripgrep respects gitignore by default and outperforms classic grep across large codebases.

slots.heroBody: Learns your habits so you can jump to folders with a single keystroke.
slots.slideSubtitle: Zoxide replaces cd with intelligent shortcuts based on frequency and recency scores.

slots.heroTitle: Modern file listings with git context
slots.heroBody: A modern, maintained replacement for ls with icons, git integration, and better defaults.
slots.slideTitle: View directories with clarity and style
slots.slideSubtitle: Eza adds color-coded metadata and hyperlinks to make file browsing actually enjoyable.

slots.heroBody: Cat clone with wings that shows syntax highlighting, git changes, and automatic paging.
slots.slideSubtitle: Bat turns plain file dumps into readable, colorized output with inline git annotations.

slots.heroBody: Cross-shell prompt that renders lang versions, git status, and execution time instantly.
slots.slideTitle: A prompt that tells your story
slots.slideSubtitle: Starship gives you exactly the context you need without cluttering your terminal window.

slots.eyebrow: the rest is up to you
slots.sublineItalic: Swap one tool at a time and watch your terminal workflow transform completely.
